title: Boston Gas Company files pursuant to G.L. c.164, § 94 and 220 C.M.R. 5.03, a 365 Day Transportation Agreement between Boston Gas Company and Eastman Gelatine Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms and minimum quantity of therms to be purchased under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection of these two elements from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
Letter to clarify that, the Company does not seek to protect the entire cover letter form public disclosure. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Boston Gas Company.
